segmentation.text: The following regulations pertain to the operation of
All vehicular travel shall be in a counterclockwise direction

elements.justification: 'vehicles' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway', with its exceptions), claimed as one atom.

st.roundabout is 'a rotary intersection: its central island, its circulatory roadway and its entry and exit approaches', which denotes DEF-LVMC-11-02-130 ('an intersection characterized by a circulatory roadway, channelized approaches and yield control of entering traffic', encompassing 'the area bounded by the outermost curb line' and including 'the crosswalks on any entering or exiting roadway': the entry and exit approaches the contract names). rel.occupies ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region') anchors 'within' to the roundabout the vehicle is in.

'vehicular travel' is the motion of the vehicle the subject span binds (the same aggregate). 'in a counterclockwise direction' is the sense of that motion about the roundabout: drv.motion.clockwise_about_region reads the vector from the region's reference point (st.region_geometry, 'the reference point and the boundary polygon of a structure region in the world frame') to the vehicle's position (kin.position) against its velocity (kin.velocity, 'velocity vector', world frame) and speed (kin.speed); its own exclusion makes it no stand-in for travel against a lane direction, so no lane marking or st.lane_direction is read. The duty is violated by clockwise motion; motion toward or away from the centre (entering, leaving) and standstill are neither sense and do not violate it.

applicability: x is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and occupies (rel.occupies) some st.roundabout region at the observation.
obligation: For every st.roundabout region r that x occupies at the observation, x is not moving clockwise about r: not drv.motion.clockwise_about_region(x, r) with speed_floor p.speed_resolution and sine_tolerance p.circulation_sine_tolerance.

narrowings.why: 'counterclockwise' is read as the sense of the vehicle's motion about the roundabout region's reference point (st.region_geometry), taken as the centre its circulatory roadway runs around, viewed from above; the duty is judged by the absence of the opposite (clockwise) sense, so a vehicle at rest or moving radially within the tolerance (entering or leaving) complies.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car on the circulatory roadway of a roundabout drives around the central island clockwise, its velocity tangential to the island.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A car on the circulatory roadway drives around the central island counter-clockwise.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A car drives clockwise around a block on ordinary streets; it occupies no roundabout region.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car is on the circulatory roadway of a roundabout and moving; the source declares kin.velocity absent, so the sense of its motion is not observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A car on an entry approach inside the roundabout's outline drives straight toward the central island before yielding: its motion is radial, neither sense.

param_proposals.name: p.speed_resolution
param_proposals.convention: Sensor resolution: the smallest speed the acquisition standard separates from standstill; a speed at or below it counts as no motion.
param_proposals.source: Ground-truth simulator kinematics sampled at 20 Hz and the speed noise of typical odometry

param_proposals.name: p.circulation_sine_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Direction tolerance: the sine of the largest angle off a radial line within which motion about a point counts as neither sense of rotation, covering heading and position noise on entry and exit paths.
param_proposals.source: Measurement tolerance of velocity direction in ground-truth simulation
